question: In basketball, a free-throw is worth how many points?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A game of Basketball is played with two teams, with 5 players from each team on the court at one time (that means 10 playing at one time).
 
• The maximum number of players on the bench differs by the league you’re playing in.

 In international play, a maximum of 7 players is allowed on the bench, resulting in a roster of 1
